submitted.rationale: Bi0.47V0.53 (index 11) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 2.17e-5 A. That is about 135x the slightly Bi-rich index 8 and higher than the more V-rich index 4 (1.73e-5 A). XRD shows monoclinic BiVO4 (Q ~1.33/1.348 split, 2.035) as the main phase. The best performance sits just on the V-rich side of 1:1 stoichiometry, which matches what is known for scheelite BiVO4 photoanodes.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.6e-7 A. Slightly Bi-rich, and photocurrent falls sharply there.
Measured 1.73e-5 A. It is monoclinic BiVO4 but has too much V, so it comes in lower than index 11.
Not measured. Its composition is almost the same as index 11, so it would likely give about the same result and was not worth the last measurement.
Photocurrent is already collapsing at Bi 0.53. Compositions further from BiVO4 stoichiometry are expected to be worse.
